sn22.17:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || Rūpam bhikkhave anattā || yad anattā taṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || 4-5-6 Vedanā anattā || Sañña anattā || Saṅkhārā anattā || || Viññāṇam anattā || yad anattā taṃ netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || || Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passam bhikkhave || la || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
